findings.title: Indexed vertex ID bias incorrectly includes element start
findings.expected: Indexed built-in vertex ID includes base vertex, not the index-buffer start; array draws retain first.
findings.observed: Patched baseline covered-pixel oracle passed 180/180 on SVGA versus 57/180 unpatched in both retained sessions; software passed 180/180 either way.
conditions: GLX pbuffer, integer attachment, explicit attribute oracle
limits: Not a complete SVGA conformance claim.

findings.title: Indirect indexed and background discrepancies remain
findings.expected: Equivalent direct and indirect draws produce matching coverage and values.
findings.observed: uint8 indirect had no coverage in the fixed reduction; uint16 indirect retained correct covered IDs, with failing SVGA background clears.
conditions: two index widths, two instances, first index17, base vertex0
limits: No claim the vertex-ID patch fixes indirect rendering.

findings.title: High unsigned framebuffer clears read back zero
findings.observed: SVGA high uploads and markers pass, but high clears become zero on either attachment; low clears and software controls pass.
limits: Readback agreement does not prove independent implementations.

findings.title: SVGA integer clear uses signed union member before float command
findings.expected: Unsigned values retain unsigned meaning or take an exact fallback.
findings.observed: Static source reads color->i for eligibility and casts it to float; H predicts -1.0f command RGB. No emitted command was captured.
conditions: no candidate patch or instrumentation implemented
limits: Host conversion and live selected path remain unverified.

findings.title: Retained Factorio shoreline replay improved
findings.expected: Remove repeated shoreline spikes without claiming all rendering defects fixed.
findings.observed: Retained patched replay removed the repeated spikes and reduced large coast-region differences from14221 to88 pixels versus software.
limits: Not a performance or complete gameplay validation.
